record.one_liner: AI notetaker that records, transcribes and writes notes for meetings, with a public API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Personal Access Token (PAT) and workspace API token are static keys (api_key). OAuth2 is offered for building integrations distributed to other Grain users.
record.access_notes: critic: access confirmed. Personal API tokens are available on every plan including Free. Workspace-wide tokens need an admin on a Business or Enterprise plan.
record.api_notes: Docs describe endpoints for recordings, highlights, uploads and token info, with Authorization header and Public-Api-Version header. No sandbox is available, so tests run against a live workspace. critic: no change.
record.blocker_notes: critic: no change; no app-review requirement found on the vendor pages.

evidence.quote: Personal Access Token (PAT): grants access on behalf of a single user.
OAuth2: the standard flow for building integrations to be used by any Grain user.
Available on every plan, including Free.
Workspace API access is available on Business and Enterprise plans and requires admin access to generate.
Every request needs a token in the Authorization header and a Public-Api-Version
The Grain MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects Claude.ai (and other AI chat clients) directly to your meeting data in Grain
Available on every plan, including Free.
